title: Request for a community parachain
body:
## Request for a community-owned KSM parachain & canarynet from Edgeware

**Summary:** This thread is a public place to debate and provide feedback on the parameters and crowdloan offer on the hotly demanded community-owned canarynet. More details on the vision, including a formal press release for this, will come, but for now, we need to focus on the core offer and technical execution and achieving alignment.

**Note **that the previous discussed canarynet Hedgeware, is no longer being developed in favor of this proposition, with the support of Drew Stone and Raymond Zhong as advisors.

---





## Description

A Kusama parachain incubated through the efforts of EDG holders, who voted to support and fund the development of a canarynet in the roadmap, and instantiated by Edgeware.Agency on their behalf.

I imagine cool is a research laboratory for interoperability and consensus tech in Substrate, governance and funding. It additionally shows that Edgeware teams are able and ready to deploy parachains with DOT auctions upcoming, offers a testing ground for teams on EDG, and provides the EDG treasury with it's first major asset: significant control of a new token.



## Technology
The code for this parachain can be based on the repo for Hedgeware. The modifications to this forked repository will feature the changes discussed later in this post.
https://github.com/Edgeware-Network/Kabocha-Parachain

## Token Economics

**Distribution**
As requested, the distribution of KAB has been closely mapped 1:1, with the only exception being a 10% community tax on all addresses to fund sustainable development of the network. See the Snapshot date discussed below.

These revenues, along with the 1:1 amount in the EDG Treasury, will be diverted into an EDG-controlled Community Fund, for incentivizing maintainers, strategic partners, and other needs. Current estimates place this new community fund at roughly 20% of the networks supply, enough to offer the new currency in the crowdlo
